response.text: I have enough to write up the notes. One last check: whether invoice-level journals and payments are linked consistently, and whether the posted journals in closed periods are in order.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'inv_jrnl_total_mismatch' k, COUNT(*)::text n FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT" <> (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("DR_AMT"),0) FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD" LIKE '5%') UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_inv_link_count', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_ap_src_not_AP', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='AP' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'post_dt_outside_period', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" UNION ALL SELECT 'post_dt_null_or_zero', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "POST_DT" IS NULL OR "POST_DT"=0;
